prompt: A login screen: logo icon, welcome title, email and password fields, a primary sign-in button, a remember-me checkbox and a link to sign up.
A dashboard with a top bar (brand, notifications bell, user avatar) and three KPI cards: visits, users, tasks.
A settings page: title, then rows for Account, Notifications, Privacy and Sign out, each with an icon and a chevron.
A product list: three items each with an image, name, short description, price and an Add button.
A profile form with full name, email, a role dropdown (Admin, Editor, Viewer), a bio textarea, a notifications switch and Cancel and Save buttons.
An admin users page: navbar, a heading, a search field and an Invite button, then a table of users with name, email, role and status.
A pricing page with three plans (Free, Pro, Team), each with a price, a feature list and a button. Pro is highlighted as most popular. Reflow to one column on narrow screens.
A mobile social feed preview: header with title and search icon, then three posts each with avatar, author name, an image and like and comment icons.
A checkout form: shipping address fields (name, address, city, postal code), a country dropdown, a payment method radio group (card, paypal) and a Pay now button.
A tabbed onboarding screen with tabs Profile, Team and Billing (Team active), and under it a form with a company name field and a Continue button.
An email inbox: sidebar with Inbox, Sent and Trash entries with icons, and a list of three messages each with sender, subject and a time.
A music player: album art image, song title and artist, a progress slider and previous, play and next icon buttons.
A project page with a Delete project button. Clicking it opens a confirmation dialog titled 'Delete project?' with a warning sentence and Cancel and Delete buttons; both close the dialog.
An app shell: a left sidebar with Dashboard, Customers and Settings entries (Dashboard active), a top bar with a menu button that collapses the sidebar, and a content area with a heading.
A table row toolbar with an Actions button that opens a dropdown menu with Edit, Duplicate and Delete (Delete in red), and a toast 'Saved' that appears after saving.
